samples.xml_description:
<module id="clkgenerator">
	<description>Clkgenerator generates a periodic clock signal based on the input parameters.</description>
	<ports>
		<input id="reset">The reset signal for the ClkGenerator.</input>
		<input id="enable">Enables the generation of the clock signal.</input>
		<input id="period">The period of the generated clock signal.</input>
		<output id="clk">The output clock signal generated by the ClkGenerator.</output>
	end
	<implementation>Generates a periodic clock signal.</implementation>
	
end</ports></module>
